tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Free. Finds companies by name, SIREN, SIRET or activity.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Free. The full fiche as Markdown, by SIREN.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Returns the URL of a PDF (statutes, decisions, annual accounts). Free when cached; costs $0.0004 when it must be fetched from the registry (INPI), paid from your balance (Authorization: Bearer) or with x402.

tools.name: signup
tools.description: Opens a prepaid account and returns its API key. No human step and no payment is needed.

tools.name: balance
tools.description: Returns the balance and recent movements of the account whose API key the transport carries.

tools.name: top_up
tools.description: Adds credit to your account. Without a payment it answers how to pay (x402, MPP, card link); pay with any listed option and call it again with the payment.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_document" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
